name: Product (output shape)
description: Defines the rule's output object — the rule's 'product'. Two modes: drop a free-form JSON shape with ${...} placeholders, or pick one of your output templates and bind each field. Domain-agnostic — could be an airline product, a tax line, an error envelope. Engine resolves placeholders against request, context, and any open iteration frames at evaluation time.

params.name: value
params.description: The shape to emit. Pick a template to fill its fields one-by-one (compiles to ${...} placeholders), or author a free-form JSON literal with placeholders inline.
